description: Defines the payload for the custom field definitions. See https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issue-fields/\#api-rest-api-3-field-post

cfType.description: The type of the custom field

description.description: The description of the custom field

name.description: The name of the custom field

onConflict.description: The strategy to use when there is a conflict with an existing custom field. FAIL - Fail execution, this always needs to be unique; USE - Use the existing entity and ignore new entity parameters

scope.description: Allows an overwrite to declare the new Custom Field to be created as a GLOBAL-scoped field. Leave this as empty or null to use the project's default scope.

searcherKey.description: The searcher key of the custom field
